lines.text: Moses says the LORD will drive out seven nations, and Israel must not intermarry with them, or their sons will serve other gods.
Israel must tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and throw their idols into the river.

wrong_details.wrong: throw their idols into the river
wrong_details.true: burn their idols in the fire

lines.text: The LORD chose Israel as His prized possession, not because they were numerous, but because He loved them and kept His oath.
Israel must remember what the LORD did to Pharaoh, and He will send the locust against the nations.
The LORD will drive out the nations little by little, hand their kings over to Israel, and no one will stand against them.
